purpose: Invariants proven by accepted work. Any change that regresses one of these is a stop-ship. Each has a guarding test or artifact.

invariants.statement: All monetary columns are bigint; DB CHECKs reject negative money and non-positive quantity.
No unsafe Number coercion of bigint money across TS/JSON/CSV/UI/provider boundaries (Lane B §11 review pending, but no regression may be introduced).
Migration parity 63/63; every migration registered; no unregistered migration.
Every admin API mount is behind authMiddleware + requirePermissions; deny-by-default; only login is unauthenticated.
Session token is validated by signature (Hs256TokenSigner) with clock-skew tolerance; disabled users (isActive=false) are rejected 403.
Checkout/quote never trusts client-supplied price/sku/name; server quote is authoritative and snapshotted (migration 0042 provenance).
Cart/order ownership enforced (owner_kind/owner_id/version, 0060); NOT_OWNED reported as CART_NOT_FOUND; guest carts use a signed credential.

Payment webhooks verify HMAC over raw body with timingSafeEqual; 401 on bad signature when secret set, 503 NOT_CONFIGURED when absent; amount compared to authoritative order total; replay blocked by idempotency; signature rejections logged without payload.
Outbox uses fenced lease (claim_token/fencing_number, 0058/0059); cross-consumer claim prevented; durable side effects.
Login/abuse limits are Redis-backed and shared across replicas; in-memory store is an explicit degraded fallback only (1/4 budget), never distributed correctness.

Client IP resolved via configured trusted-proxy topology (CADDY_EDGE/CLOUDFLARE_EDGE/DIRECT), fails closed in production; untrusted X-Forwarded-For / CF headers are not trusted outside the configured edge; unattributable claims bucket to x:unattributed and cannot consume a real client's quota.

Measurement admin pages call the API only through the same-origin allowlisted proxy that attaches the bearer token server-side from the HttpOnly session cookie; no phantom localStorage token; exact path+method allowlist.
Stock reservation via reserved_quantity + ledger (0053); available-to-promise clamps at zero; oversell prevented.
Consent routing is canonical (single consent-operating layer); no hardcoded consent_satisfied; destination routing respects consent.

Refresh tokens are single-use: rotation atomically consumes the old credential (conditional UPDATE) and mints a new one in the same family; replay of a consumed credential is detected and revokes the whole family. Only the SHA-256 hash is stored. Correctness holds with Redis down (source of truth is PostgreSQL).

Privileged actions require a fresh MFA step-up (5-min window); an enrolled-but-stale or non-enrolled user is denied, not downgraded (self-bypass denial). TOTP is RFC 6238; the secret is AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest; recovery codes are SHA-256 hashed and single-use.

A state-changing, cookie-authenticated request must carry an allowlisted Origin (Referer fallback). Bearer/no-cookie requests and HMAC provider webhooks are exempt; the webhook exemption stays narrow (/webhooks/ prefix only).
Every PostgreSQL integration suite owns a unique schema and sets search_path; cleanup touches only suite-owned objects; no unscoped DROP TABLE / TRUNCATE.
invariants.guard: tests/integration/* pattern (e.g. mig0062 schema) + destructive-SQL guard (Slice 3/12)

invariants.statement: An unexpected (non-domain) error never returns err.message to the client and is a generic INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; DB failures are classified by SQLSTATE code, never by matching the message text; logs redact PII/secrets.

During shutdown, readiness (/health/ready) goes 503 BEFORE sockets close, while liveness (/health/live) stays 200, so the load balancer drains the instance instead of racing a request into a closing socket.

Order status changes go through the OrderStateMachine: terminal states (completed/cancelled/failed) cannot transition out; you cannot skip states (e.g. received→completed); pending_payment→processing requires payment_status=paid. Enforced in the domain entity (throws) and the governance route.

Commerce integrity reconciliation SURFACES money/inventory drift and never mutates: order total=subtotal+delivery, subtotal=Σ(line finalLineTotal), product.reserved=Σ(active reservation ledger), reserved≤stock.

Product data-quality scores are deterministic and transparent: each 0-100 sub-score (completeness/feed/SEO/AEO/assistant) lists its concrete missing signals; feed eligibility is all-or-nothing over required fields; no score is fabricated for empty data.

RFM scores are quintiles within the real customer population (not magic thresholds), computed from PAID orders only; unpaid/failed orders never inflate monetary or reset recency; a never-purchased customer scores at the bottom, not hidden.

The self-service explorer can only query catalogue-approved metrics/dimensions/filters; any unknown key is rejected before the DB; filter VALUES are always bound parameters (never concatenated into SQL); text filters honour a value allowlist; row count is capped. Money metric is labelled GMV, never revenue.

Provider match identity: phone normalised to E.164 before hashing (equivalent forms hash identically); only SHA-256 hashed, allowlisted fields are emitted; nothing is emitted without consent; RAW PII (email/phone) never appears in the payload. This is a readiness contract — no real provider send.
